note: Everyone who speaks or is named in Docs/CampaignBible.md and Docs/Story.md, except Warrok (retired, never added). code is the speaker letter in Story.cs lines (C, B and T are directives and tips, not speakers). colour is the name and the portrait disc. portrait is an optional Resources path; with no file the dialogue box draws a stand-in disc with the glyph. voice is the hook: wallit and slice speak through WallitVoice and SliceVoice, bark means the Cast.LineSpoken hook only (Resources/Voice/<id>_<line>.mp3 when it exists), none is text alone.
